en: You find something valuable and do not know who owns it.
ph_ar: لقيت حاجة غالية في الشارع وما نعرفش مولاها
ph_en: I found something valuable and don't know who it belongs to

en: You have a chance to benefit from a mistake nobody noticed.
ph_ar: الكاشير غلط في الحساب لصالحي وحتى حد ما فاق
ph_en: The cashier gave me too much change and nobody noticed

en: A group pressures you to do something against your convictions.
ph_ar: صحابي يضغطوا علي باش نعمل حاجة ضد مبادئي
ph_en: My friends are pressuring me to do something I don't believe in

en: You lie to avoid an embarrassing situation and then regret it.
ph_ar: كذبت باش نهرب من موقف محرج وندمت
ph_en: I lied to get out of an awkward situation and now I regret it

en: You hear a rumour and wonder whether to pass it on or stop it.
ph_ar: سمعت إشاعة على واحد ومحتار نحكيها ولا نسكت
ph_en: I heard a rumour about someone and I'm not sure whether to share it

en: You witness an injustice and are afraid to defend the victim.
ph_ar: شفت ظلم وخفت ندافع على المظلوم
ph_en: I saw someone being treated unfairly and was too scared to step in

en: You disagree with someone you respect on a religious or intellectual matter.
ph_ar: اختلفت مع شيخ نحترمه في مسألة
ph_en: I disagree with someone I respect on a religious question

en: You try to keep up an act of worship or a good habit and then stop.
ph_ar: كل مرة نبدا نصلي قيام الليل ونقطع
ph_en: I keep starting a good habit and dropping it

en: You feel guilty about an old mistake.
ph_ar: غلطة قديمة مازالت تعذبني
ph_en: An old sin still haunts me

en: You must choose between your own interest and keeping a promise.
ph_ar: وعدت صاحبي وتوا الوفاء بالوعد يضرني
ph_en: Keeping my promise will cost me, and I'm torn

en: Someone asks you about something you do not know and you are tempted to pretend.
ph_ar: سألوني على حاجة ما نعرفهاش وحبيت نعمل روحي نعرف
ph_en: Someone asked me something I didn't know and I was tempted to bluff

en: You admit a mistake despite fearing the consequences.
ph_ar: بدي أعترف بغلطتي بس خايف من العواقب
ph_en: I want to admit my mistake but I'm scared of what will happen

en: You are asked to give testimony that does not match the truth.
ph_ar: طالبين مني نشهد بحاجة ماهيش صحيحة
ph_en: I'm being asked to testify to something that isn't true

en: You want to forgive someone but cannot regain your trust in them.
ph_ar: نحب نسامحو بس الثقة ما رجعتش
ph_en: I want to forgive him but I can't trust him again

en: You hesitate between helping others and protecting your own limits.
ph_ar: نحب نعاون الناس بس ولّيت نتعب على حساب روحي
ph_en: I want to help others but I keep neglecting myself

en: You discover your judgement of someone was too hasty.
ph_ar: حكمت على واحد بسرعة وطلع إنسان باهي
ph_en: I judged someone too quickly and I was wrong about him

en: You are offered a bribe or a favour in exchange for breaking the rules.
ph_ar: عرضوا علي رشوة باش نسكّر عيني
ph_en: Someone offered me a bribe to look the other way

en: You defend your opinion and then realise it was wrong.
ph_ar: دافعت على رايي بقوة وبعد عرفت أني غالط
ph_en: I argued hard for my opinion and then realised I was wrong

en: You try to return what is due to someone after many years.
ph_ar: بدي أرجّع حق لصاحبه بعد سنين
ph_en: I want to return something I owe someone from years ago

en: You choose to do the right thing even though no one will appreciate it.
ph_ar: عملت الصح وحتى حد ما قدر
ph_en: I did the right thing and nobody noticed

en: You get lost in an unfamiliar place.
ph_ar: تهت في بلاصة ما نعرفهاش
ph_en: I'm lost in a place I don't know

en: You miss a flight or a train.
ph_ar: فاتتني الطيارة
ph_en: I missed my flight

en: You arrive in a new country without speaking its language.
ph_ar: وصلت لبلد جديد وما نعرفش اللغة
ph_en: I've moved to a new country and don't speak the language

en: You lose your passport while travelling.
ph_ar: ضاع جواز سفري وأنا مسافر
ph_en: I lost my passport while travelling

en: A cultural difference causes a misunderstanding.
ph_ar: صار سوء فهم بسبب اختلاف الثقافة
ph_en: A cultural difference caused a misunderstanding with a colleague

en: The weather forces you to change your plans.
ph_ar: الطقس خرّب كل برنامجي
ph_en: The weather ruined all my plans

en: Your car breaks down on a remote road.
ph_ar: الكرهبة طاحت بيا في طريق بعيدة
ph_en: My car broke down in the middle of nowhere

en: A dispute with a neighbour over noise.
ph_ar: الجار يعمل حس كل ليلة وتخاصمنا
ph_en: I'm fighting with my neighbour about the noise

en: You are treated unfairly by a public service.
ph_ar: تعاملوا معايا بظلم في الإدارة
ph_en: I was treated unfairly at a government office

en: You wait in a queue for a long time and someone cuts in.
ph_ar: استنيت برشا في الطابور وواحد تعداني
ph_en: I waited ages in line and someone pushed in front of me

en: You send a private message to the wrong person.
ph_ar: بعثت رسالة خاصة للشخص الغالط
ph_en: I sent a private message to the wrong person

en: You post something online and then regret it.
ph_ar: نشرت حاجة على الفيسبوك وندمت
ph_en: I posted something online and regret it

en: You lose photos and memories because your phone broke.
ph_ar: ضاعوا تصاويري الكل كي تكسر التلفون
ph_en: I lost all my photos when my phone broke

en: You move into a new home and feel unsettled.
ph_ar: بدلت الدار وما زلت ما ارتحتش
ph_en: We moved house and I still don't feel settled

en: You face an important decision between two good options.
ph_ar: عندي زوز اختيارات باهين ومحتار
ph_en: I have two good options and I can't choose

en: An event you had long looked forward to is cancelled.
ph_ar: تلغات المناسبة اللي كنت نستنى فيها
ph_en: The event I'd been waiting for was cancelled

en: You achieve a dream and find it did not give you the feeling you expected.
ph_ar: حققت حلمي وما حسيتش بالفرحة اللي توقعتها
ph_en: I achieved my dream and still feel empty

en: You retire or leave a familiar role and look for new meaning in your day.
ph_ar: تقاعدت وما عادش نعرف شنو نعمل بنهاري
ph_en: I retired and don't know what to do with my days

en: You get a second chance after an earlier failure.
ph_ar: جاتني فرصة ثانية بعد ما فشلت
ph_en: I've been given a second chance after failing

en: You stand at a new beginning and feel fear and hope together.
ph_ar: نبدا مرحلة جديدة وخايف ومتفائل في نفس الوقت
ph_en: I'm starting something new and feel scared and hopeful at once

en: You arrive in a new country and feel you are starting life from zero.
ph_ar: جيت لبلد جديد وحاسس نبدا من الصفر
ph_en: I moved abroad and feel like I'm starting from zero

en: You miss your family and cannot visit them because of work or travel costs.
ph_ar: توحشت أهلي وما نقدرش نزورهم
ph_en: I miss my family and can't afford to visit

en: You fall ill abroad and have no one to look after you.
ph_ar: مرضت في الغربة وحتى حد ما بجنبي
ph_en: I got sick abroad and there's no one to look after me

en: You spend Eid far from your family and miss its atmosphere at home.
ph_ar: العيد في الغربة من غير عائلتي
ph_en: Spending Eid alone abroad without my family

en: You hear of a loved one's death and cannot attend the funeral.
ph_ar: جدتي ماتت وما نجمتش نحضر الجنازة
ph_en: My grandmother died and I couldn't go to the funeral

en: You struggle to express your needs in the local language.
ph_ar: ما نعرفش نعبّر على روحي بلغة البلاد
ph_en: I can't express what I need in the local language

en: You are mistreated because of your name, accent or origin.
ph_ar: يعاملوني خايب خاطر اسمي عربي
ph_en: People treat me badly because of my name and where I'm from

en: You struggle to make friends despite living there for some time.
ph_ar: عندي سنين هنا وما عنديش صحاب
ph_en: I've lived here for years and still have no friends

en: You hesitate between integrating and keeping your customs and identity.
ph_ar: محتار بين الاندماج والمحافظة على هويتي
ph_en: I'm torn between fitting in and keeping my identity

en: Your children grow up with a different language and culture and you fear they will drift from their roots.
ph_ar: خايف ولادي يكبروا بعيد على أصلهم
ph_en: I'm afraid my kids are losing their roots growing up abroad

en: You disagree with your children about what home and belonging mean.
ph_ar: ولادي يقولوا البلاد هذي هي بلادهم
ph_en: My children and I disagree about where home really is

en: You are waiting for your residence permit renewal and worry about your stability.
ph_ar: نستنى في تجديد الإقامة وخايف
ph_en: I'm anxious waiting for my residence permit renewal

en: Your degree or experience is not recognised, so you work in another field.
ph_ar: شهادتي ما يعترفوش بيها هنا ونخدم في حاجة أخرى
ph_en: My degree isn't recognised here so I'm stuck in another job

en: Your family thinks life abroad is easy and it is hard to explain your struggles.
ph_ar: أهلي يحسابو الغربة جنة
ph_en: My family thinks life abroad is easy and doesn't understand

en: You send money to your family while you face financial pressure yourself.
ph_ar: نبعث لأهلي فلوس وأنا نفسي مضيّق
ph_en: I send money home while I'm struggling myself

en: You miss your brother's wedding or sister's graduation.
ph_ar: فاتني عرس خويا وأنا في الغربة
ph_en: I missed my brother's wedding because I'm abroad

en: You watch your parents age over video calls and feel helpless.
ph_ar: نشوف والديا كبروا في الفيديو وما نقدر نعمل شي
ph_en: I watch my parents get older on video calls and feel helpless

en: You need to understand housing, insurance or tax procedures and do not know who can help.
ph_ar: ما فهمت شي في الضرائب والتأمين هنا
ph_en: I don't understand the tax and insurance system here

en: You are afraid to ask for help because you do not know your rights or the language.
ph_ar: نخاف نطلب مساعدة خاطر ما نعرفش حقوقي
ph_en: I'm afraid to ask for help because I don't know my rights

en: You miss simple things from home: food, dialect, family gatherings.
ph_ar: توحشت الماكلة متاع أمي والقعدات
ph_en: I miss my mum's cooking and family gatherings

en: You visit your homeland and discover people and places have changed.
ph_ar: رجعت للبلاد ولقيت كل شي تبدل
ph_en: I went back home and everything had changed

en: You feel a stranger where you live and no longer fully belong to your country of origin.
ph_ar: لا هنا مرتاح ولا في بلادي
ph_en: I don't belong here and I no longer belong back home

en: You and your spouse disagree about returning home or settling abroad.
ph_ar: مرتي تبي نرجعو وأنا نحب نقعد
ph_en: My wife wants to go back home and I want to stay

en: You want to return but fear losing what you built abroad.
ph_ar: نحب نروّح بس خايف نخسر اللي بنيتو
ph_en: I want to go home but I'm afraid to lose everything I built here

en: You feel guilty for being far from your family although you left to improve your lives.
ph_ar: نحس بالذنب خاطر بعيد على أهلي
ph_en: I feel guilty for living so far from my family

en: You compare yourself to other expatriates and think you are behind.
ph_ar: المغتربين الآخرين نجحوا وأنا لا
ph_en: Other people who moved abroad seem to be doing better than me

en: You look for a place to practise your faith or meet people who share your culture.
ph_ar: نلوج على جامع وناس من ثقافتي
ph_en: I'm looking for a mosque and people from my culture

en: You are exploited in housing or work because you do not know the system.
ph_ar: مولى الدار يستغلني خاطر ما نعرفش القانون
ph_en: My landlord takes advantage of me because I don't know the system

en: A local person helps you and you feel welcome for the first time.
ph_ar: جاري ساعدني وحسيت لأول مرة أني مرحّب بيا
ph_en: A local helped me and I felt welcome for the first time

en: You build a stable life abroad and learn to stay connected to home.
ph_ar: استقريت هنا وحاب نحافظ على صلتي ببلادي
ph_en: I've settled abroad and want to stay connected to home

en: You arrive at an appointment and discover you brought the wrong documents.
ph_ar: مشيت للموعد ونسيت الوثيقة المطلوبة
ph_en: I went to my appointment with the wrong documents

en: Family reunification papers are delayed and your separation drags on.
ph_ar: أوراق لمّ الشمل تأخرت وعائلتي بعيدة
ph_en: Family reunification is taking forever and I miss my family

en: You need to translate an old certificate that is hard to obtain.
ph_ar: لازمني نترجم شهادة قديمة وصعيب نجيبها
ph_en: I need an old certificate translated and it's hard to get

en: Your application is rejected because of a small spelling mistake in your name.
ph_ar: رفضوا ملفي على غلطة في كتابة اسمي
ph_en: My application was rejected because of a typo in my name

en: You receive an official letter in a language you do not understand, with a deadline to reply.
ph_ar: جاتني رسالة رسمية ما فهمتهاش وفيها أجل
ph_en: I got an official letter I can't understand with a deadline

en: You move house and forget to update your address with the authorities.
ph_ar: نسيت نبدل العنوان في البلدية
ph_en: I moved and forgot to update my address with the authorities

en: Your residence permit is tied to your job, so changing jobs makes you anxious.
ph_ar: الإقامة مربوطة بالخدمة وخايف نبدل
ph_en: My visa is tied to my job so I'm scared to change jobs

en: You need to travel while your passport is held by an authority.
ph_ar: لازمني نسافر والباسبور عند الإدارة
ph_en: I need to travel but my passport is with the immigration office

en: Your name is spelled differently on your passport and certificates.
ph_ar: اسمي مكتوب بطريقة مختلفة في الأوراق
ph_en: My name is spelled differently on my passport and my diplomas

en: You are asked to prove something for which no document exists in your home country.
ph_ar: طالبين وثيقة ما فماش منها في بلادي
ph_en: They want a document that doesn't exist in my home country
